insight: In this repo a `git grep -n` guard reports `path:line:text`, so a stale identifier inside a directory that is itself being renamed shows up as a survivor before the rename and silently stops being one after it — the filter must pin the identifier, never rely on the path prefix.

A spec that shells out to the repo-wide 'git grep farol' guard is itself grepped, so every mention of the old name inside it must use the 'f[a]rol' character-class idiom or the suite can never go green.
